judge_edits.reason: Blind item 34 applied: postfix «+» after «млн» reads as foreign infographic notation; «Более 2,5 млн» is the stage-5 alternative and matches «более чем 2,5 млн» in ru home.hero.lead and «пальм…» label (genitive after млн holds). Capitalised as the card display line (sibling «Тысячи»; de «Über 2,5 Mio.»). Width: 13 characters, same as the approved de card «Über 2,5 Mio.» in the same 4-column .fact-n (t-2xl) grid; collapses to 2 and 1 columns on narrow viewports. Accepted.

blind_disposition.25: Inserted «предвечерние часы, когда спадает жара» drew no stumble; kept. Repetition of «лайм Аль-Ахсы», «сюда», «ферма лайма» inherited (termbase name), out of scope.
blind_disposition.34: APPLIED (judge edit: «2,5 млн+» -> «Более 2,5 млн»). Reader note that extraction glued number to label: page structure, not a defect.

source_defects: Items 1-2: home route timings (Qarah sunset day 1 / Qaisariyah noon) contradict the 48-hours article (Qarah morning day 2 / Qaisariyah evening; farm late afternoon). Source-level, raised to Eyad.
out_of_scope: Items 3-24, 26-33, 35-41: outside batch scope (day-2 heading kept by Eyad decision; «Рассвет» for the palace; transliterations read as Russian words; Залив; UI labels; ё), unscored, raised to Eyad.
